findings.title: plot.ipynb 'Coloring by hue' (cell 26) and 'Adding a legend' (cell 29) crash on fresh execution: hue length 8120 != 8124 rows
findings.expected: Tutorial cell colors the mushrooms scatter into 5 equal groups and renders a figure (as the committed output depicts).
findings.actual: ValueError: hue has 8120 entries but the data has 8124 observations; hue must have exactly one value (or one row, for a matrix hue) per observation.

findings.title: analyze.ipynb states weights elements are '(300,100)' / '300 TRs' but actual (and committed) shape is (100,100)
findings.expected: Comment/markdown match the data and committed output: elements are (100,100).
findings.actual: cell 6 comment '# 300 TRs and 100 components'; cell 7 markdown 'each have the dimensions (300,100)'; actual/committed shape (100, 100).

findings.title: align.ipynb describes its dataset as 'a list of 2 numpy arrays ... from 18 subjects' but hyp.load('weights') returns 36 arrays of (300,100)
findings.expected: Description matches loaded data: 36 subject arrays of shape (300,100).
findings.actual: markdown: 'a list of 2 numpy arrays, each ... from 18 subjects'; actual: 36 arrays of (300,100).

findings.title: plot.ipynb text section claims to load 'all State of the Union Addresses from 1989-2017' but the code uses 4 hard-coded sample sentences
findings.repro: grep -n 'all State of the Union' docs/tutorials/plot.ipynb ; grep -n 'sample_sotus_speeches' docs/tutorials/plot.ipynb
findings.expected: Prose matches code -- either load the real sotus dataset, or reword to say 'a few example sentences'.
findings.actual: markdown promises 'all State of the Union Addresses from 1989-2017'; code defines a 4-element list of demo sentences.

findings.title: Tutorials teach the deprecated reduce syntax {'model':...,'params':{...}}; reduce.ipynb emits a fresh DeprecationWarning (plot/analyze silently swallow it)
findings.repro: cd /Users/jmanning/hypertools && MPLBACKEND=Agg .venv/bin/python -W always -c "import hypertools as hyp;w=hyp.load('weights_avg');hyp.reduce(w, reduce={'model':'PCA','params':{'whiten':True}}, ndims=3)" 2>&1 | grep -i deprecat
findings.expected: Tutorials use the current, non-deprecated reduce parameter syntax (model + kwargs), and all three entry points (reduce/plot/analyze) agree on whether 'params' is deprecated.
findings.actual: DeprecationWarning: {'model': ..., 'params': {...}} is deprecated; use {'model': ..., 'args': [...], 'kwargs': {...}} instead  (fires only via hyp.reduce; plot/analyze emit nothing)

findings.title: align.ipynb group split drops subject index 17 (np.mean(data[:17]) + np.mean(data[18:]) over 36 subjects)
findings.repro: cd /Users/jmanning/hypertools && .venv/bin/python -c "import hypertools as hyp;d=hyp.load('weights');print('n=',len(d),'group1 uses',len(d[:17]),'group2 uses',len(d[18:]),'-> index 17 dropped')"
findings.expected: Both groups together cover all 36 subjects (e.g. data[:18] and data[18:]).
findings.actual: group1 uses 17 subjects (0-16), group2 uses 18 (18-35); subject index 17 excluded.

findings.title: Inconsistent 'supported models' lists: UMAP listed in reduce cell 2 & plot cell 19 but omitted in reduce cell 24 & analyze cell 15 (UMAP is supported)
findings.expected: All supported-model lists match and include UMAP (or consistently exclude it if unsupported).
findings.actual: reduce cell2/plot cell19 include UMAP; reduce cell24/analyze cell15 omit it; UMAP works.
